baseline.inventory: 24 Primary and 47 Property Declarations, per task scope

ownership_rule: A Node Declaration constrains relation degree only where its selected Node is the relation host. A target kind may be named, but a target-side degree belongs in that target Node's own Declaration. Inverse views constrain the same logical link and do not require a second authored inverse fact.

proposals.change: Move Workflow-to-Step degree onto Workflow's outgoing CONTAINS relation and normalize it to `{:1+}`.

non_violations: Node-wide property-bearing constraints select their declared Node branch rather than a foreign Node host.
Property RHS reads such as `$parent.structural_level` read a target value; they do not constrain target relation degree.
Qualified broader-Atom Property constraints and conditional selected Role definitions remain valid where the declared subject is the selected host class.
Target kind references, including `(in (Step, Substep))//`, are allowed when no opposite-node count is attached.
residual_issues: `Project//{1}` and `Package/Implementation//{1}` are singleton selector forms, not relation-degree suffixes; no change is proposed in this ownership pass.
Relation Definitions or global invariants may retain two-end count schematics outside Node Declarations.
The proposal assumes concurrent canonical `{:n}` notation and binding/membership rules are accepted before application.
